What's in your free Aurora Student plan?

The Student plan has equal usage limits to the Aurora Pro plan. Claim applies to one workspace. SMS authentication is the only feature excluded from the Student plan, which students can choose to upgrade at any time.

  • Pro features

    Multi-factor authentication, one enterprise connection, the removal of Aurora branding, a custom session lifetime, and more.

  • Generous user capacity

    50,000 monthly retained users included, giving you plenty of room to grow before graduation.

  • B2B SaaS ready

    Aurora Organizations makes multi-tenancy simple, with a full suite of features built for B2B SaaS.

  • Billing

    The easiest way to add subscriptions to your application - no Stripe integration required, no upfront costs, and pricing based only on what you bill.

  • Team dashboard

    Invite up to two other team members to collaborate in the Aurora dashboard.

  • Unlimited social connections

    Let users sign in with social providers like Google, GitHub, or Facebook.

Frequently asked questions about the Aurora Student plan

The GitHub Student Developer Pack is a program that provides free access to GitHub for students. Learn more about the GitHub Student Developer Pack⁠.

The Student plan has equal usage limits to the Aurora Pro plan. Claim applies to one workspace. SMS Authentication is the only feature excluded from the Student plan, which students can choose to upgrade to at any time as they wish.

Your access to the Aurora Student plan is valid until you finish your studies and graduate from the GitHub Student Developer Pack. Please note that students are required to keep their GitHub account connected to be able to claim and access their Student plan.

If you already have a workspace with a Student plan, you will not be eligible to claim it to another workspace. You can always upgrade to the Pro plan as a regular user to leverage multiple workspaces.

Workspaces are a way to group applications and resources together. You may have multiple applications under one workspace. When you create a Aurora account in the Aurora Dashboard, you are automatically added to a workspace called your Personal workspace. You can edit the name of this workspace, along with other settings, on the Aurora Dashboard's Settings page. Learn more about Workspaces.

If you graduate or leave your educational institution, you will no longer be eligible for the GitHub Student Developer Pack. Your account will be downgraded to the Hobby plan and all the benefits of the Student plan will be lost.

What's in your free Aurora Student plan?

The Student plan has equal usage limits to the Aurora Pro plan. Claim applies to one workspace. SMS authentication is the only feature excluded from the Student plan, which students can choose to upgrade at any time.

  • Pro features

    Multi-factor authentication, one enterprise connection, the removal of Aurora branding, a custom session lifetime, and more.

  • Generous user capacity

    50,000 monthly retained users included, giving you plenty of room to grow before graduation.

  • B2B SaaS ready

    Aurora Organizations makes multi-tenancy simple, with a full suite of features built for B2B SaaS.

  • Billing

    The easiest way to add subscriptions to your application - no Stripe integration required, no upfront costs, and pricing based only on what you bill.

  • Team dashboard

    Invite up to two other team members to collaborate in the Aurora dashboard.

  • Unlimited social connections

    Let users sign in with social providers like Google, GitHub, or Facebook.

Frequently asked questions about the Aurora Student plan

The GitHub Student Developer Pack is a program that provides free access to GitHub for students. Learn more about the GitHub Student Developer Pack⁠.

The Student plan has equal usage limits to the Aurora Pro plan. Claim applies to one workspace. SMS Authentication is the only feature excluded from the Student plan, which students can choose to upgrade to at any time as they wish.

Your access to the Aurora Student plan is valid until you finish your studies and graduate from the GitHub Student Developer Pack. Please note that students are required to keep their GitHub account connected to be able to claim and access their Student plan.

If you already have a workspace with a Student plan, you will not be eligible to claim it to another workspace. You can always upgrade to the Pro plan as a regular user to leverage multiple workspaces.

Workspaces are a way to group applications and resources together. You may have multiple applications under one workspace. When you create a Aurora account in the Aurora Dashboard, you are automatically added to a workspace called your Personal workspace. You can edit the name of this workspace, along with other settings, on the Aurora Dashboard's Settings page. Learn more about Workspaces.

If you graduate or leave your educational institution, you will no longer be eligible for the GitHub Student Developer Pack. Your account will be downgraded to the Hobby plan and all the benefits of the Student plan will be lost.
